# [TASK] Replace inline qualified class names with static imports in tests

## Task
Test classes across the backend had inline fully-qualified or class-qualified
calls (`org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows(...)`,
`Assertions.assertEquals(...)`) instead of static imports, adding noise at
every call site. Sweep the backend test tree, convert every qualified
JUnit/AssertJ/Mockito/Hamcrest/MockMvc call site to a static import, and
codify the convention as mandatory in the Cursor rules so it does not drift
back.

## No parent
Backend test-style cleanup, not covered by any open Story's acceptance
criteria. Not #77: that Story's criteria track dependency bumps, toolchain
upgrades, and pure chores (dead-file cleanup, doc archiving), not test-code
convention changes.

## Scope
Backend test sources only (`backend/**/src/test/**/*.java`). Main-source
qualified calls and frontend code are out of scope.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] No fully-qualified or class-qualified call to `Assertions`, `Mockito`,
      `ArgumentMatchers`, `BDDMockito`, `Matchers`/`CoreMatchers`, or
      `MockMvcRequestBuilders`/`MockMvcResultMatchers`/`MockMvcResultHandlers`
      remains outside an import statement in `backend/**/src/test/**/*.java`
      (`grep -rnE 'Mockito\.|ArgumentMatchers\.|BDDMockito\.|MockMvcRequestBuilders\.|MockMvcResultMatchers\.|MockMvcResultHandlers\.|CoreMatchers\.|Assertions\.(assert|fail)' backend --include='*.java'`, no matches outside import lines)
- [x] `.cursor/rules/spring-boot-development.mdc` states static imports are
      mandatory in test code, with a bad/good example (`## B.1 Static
      Imports Are MANDATORY in Test Code`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 1

## Notes
6 files had real violations: `MovieControllerErrorTest`, `PrometheusEndpointTest`,
`AiServiceIntegrationTest` (movie-service/ai-service), and
`MediaControllerTest`/`MediaFileTest`/`MediaServiceTest` (media-service).
`spotlessApply`/`compileTestJava` and the touched modules' fast
(non-Testcontainers) suites were not re-verified this audit; the grep sweep
above is the regression check going forward.
